name: rapier
description: A fast, open source Markdown editor and note-taking app with a canvas, right in your chat. ChatGPT writes, diagrams, draws and paints in your document where you can watch and undo anything. You can also use Rapier's JPEG XL encoder to convert images, GIFs and videos to .jxl files, which are much smaller at the same quality. No account, no ads or tracking.

interface.longDescription:
Rapier is a fast, open source Markdown editor and note-taking app with a canvas, and it opens right in your chat. It also has a Draw mode with an SVG editor, brushes, watercolors and typographic art. Supports Mermaid diagrams and flowcharts.

Collaborate on art or words with ChatGPT. Your assistant writes, diagrams, draws and paints where you can watch and undo anything, and you can change anything yourself. The diagrams ChatGPT makes for you are fully customizable so you can rearrange and relabel them.

Everything is plain Markdown. Pictures, drawings and paintings are embedded inside the file in two standard formats (JPEG XL and SVG) with optional fallbacks to other image formats. Documents in Rapier are single files you can open in other Markdown apps or any browser, now or in 20 years.

Writing

Notes, plans, lists, letters and reports that you keep working on. Formatting includes lists, tables, footnotes, code with syntax highlighting and LaTeX equations done properly. Find and replace, proper undo, compare, light and dark themes. Every change ChatGPT makes is marked, it undoes its own edits without touching yours, and it can show you two versions side by side before anything changes.

Drawing

Ask for a flowchart and drag its boxes where you want them. Sketch with a finger, your mouse or a stylus. Boxes and arrows stay tidy automatically. Drawings are SVGs so they stay sharp and editable, and they can be exported in multiple formats easily.

Painting

Paint in realistic watercolor with fluid simulation, spectral color blending, spreading and drying. Everything is designed for painting with your finger, but you can use a mouse or stylus too. Ask ChatGPT to paint and it paints right in the chat, then pick up the brush on the same sheet. Raster brush mode uses the open MyPaint preset format and includes many factory brushes like oil, bristle, feather and pencil. Watercolor needs WebGPU, as in current Chrome or Edge. Where the chat has none, ChatGPT gives you a link to paint in a browser that has it.

JPEG XL

Use Rapier's JPEG XL encoder to convert images, GIFs and videos to .jxl files, which are much smaller at the same quality, and convert .jxl files back to JPEG or PNG. Pictures convert on your device. The open source rapier-jxl encoder keeps text sharp inside compressed images such as screenshots, automatically.

Keep and share

Export to Markdown, Word, PDF, text or an HTML page that opens offline in any browser. You can also share a single HTML file with the Rapier editor inside. Anyone can open it offline, make changes and export an updated copy to send back with history preserved. Leave comments and suggest edits. Open the same document in your own browser and tap a link to allow it in the chat.

Open source. Works offline with no install. No account, no tracking, no ads.
defaultPrompt: Write a weekend garden plan in Rapier, tighten it, and show me both versions side by side.
Draw a flowchart in Rapier of how a web request works, with boxes I can move around.
Write a day-hike packing list in Rapier and export it as an HTML file I can edit offline.

review.commerce_description: The plugin and hosted collaborative editor are free. They do not sell products, process payments, or include a checkout.

positive.description: Create and read a document from an ask that names no app. Start a new chat with Rapier connected and no existing workspace. Use the exact sample text in the prompt; it contains no private data. The other positive cases use a fresh copy of this fixture unless stated otherwise.
positive.prompt:
Make this a document I can keep editing, named garden-plan.md, and tell me its structure:

# Garden plan

We will plant tomatos on Friday.

## Steps

1. Prepare the bed.
2. Plant the seedlings.
3. Water the soil.
positive.expected_behavior: open receives the supplied Markdown and filename garden-plan.md, and returns revision 0 with the whole text. The document value is kept private; editor_url may be shared. read with as "outline" (or the text open returned) gives the Garden plan and Steps headings. The Rapier editor appears inline with the exact text. A successful call alone is not proof that the editor appeared.

positive.description: Correct, compare, export and undo only the assistant's change. First complete case 1 with the unmodified fixture so tomatos appears exactly once. The reviewer must see both versions' text in the actual inline comparison, not only its title or controls. Between the two prompts, type a new last step in the editor by hand; that later human line must survive.
positive.prompt:
Fix only tomatos to tomatoes in the garden plan. Then show me, side by side, what the plan would look like without step 1, but don't change it.

(After typing a new last step by hand:) Save the garden plan, give me a Markdown file and an offline HTML copy, then undo only your tomatoes correction and keep what I added.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant may read with query tomatos first. edit sends one exact change (old: the sentence with tomatos, new: the same sentence with tomatoes) at the current revision and reports applied with an act id; the inline editor visibly shows the correction. show with target "comparison", a name and the whole alternative plan as text opens the comparison without changing the source. The reviewer sees readable original and proposed text side by side, including the omitted first step. A title, receipt or blank comparison body does not pass this visible-content check; report it as unverified or failed. read afterwards returns the corrected plan with all three steps. export with to "save" reports saved, verified and destination workspace; the assistant explains that this is a hosted workspace save, not a download. export with to "file" and format markdown returns a link to a file whose bytes are the exact source, and with format html a link to one offline page that is the whole editor with the document inside. undo receives the correction's act id and reports applied: tomatos is restored and the person's typed line is kept, as read confirms. A conflict is reported, not hidden.

positive.description: Create a diagram the person drags by hand, from an ask that names no app. Start a new chat with Rapier connected and no existing workspace. The reviewer moves a box in the actual ChatGPT editor; this is a manual interaction check.
positive.prompt: Draw this as a diagram I can rearrange by dragging the boxes: Prepare the bed, then Plant the seedlings, then Water the soil, with arrows in that order.
positive.expected_behavior: read with guide "draw" returns the drawing instructions. open creates a document whose text holds a rapier-draw block with three labeled boxes and arrows from Prepare to Plant and Plant to Water. The diagram appears in the inline editor. The reviewer selects the diagram, chooses Draw, drags one box and chooses Done; the arrows stay attached. A later read shows only that box's position changed in the drawing data.

positive.description: Convert a picture to JPEG XL with the converter's own picker. Start a new chat with Rapier connected and attach no picture; the person picks one in the converter. Run in the actual ChatGPT host.
positive.prompt: Open the Rapier JPEG XL converter so I can pick a photo and convert it.
positive.expected_behavior: convert is called without files and the converter appears inline with its own picker. The reviewer picks any picture on the device; it converts there and a .jxl file can be saved. The picture does not reach Rapier's server. A converter link in text alone does not pass.

positive.description: Paint watercolor in the chat, then keep painting in a browser paired with nothing typed. Start a new chat with Rapier connected, on a phone or computer whose browser has WebGPU (current Chrome or Edge, or ChatGPT's app on a recent phone). The reviewer touches the chat's view, then opens editor_url in a second browser.
positive.prompt: Paint me a small watercolor of a sunset over green hills, here in the chat.
positive.expected_behavior: read with guide "water" returns the Water instructions. open creates a document (in one call, or followed by edit with an operation_id that lays a rapier-water fence). Rapier's view in the chat paints the watercolor itself, with no link or code; the reviewer's first touch opens it full screen, the note says Painting while the paint lands, and Paint beside Undo hands the person the brush on the same sheet. Where Water is unavailable in the chat, the assistant gives editor_url to open in a browser with WebGPU and never paints it another way. Pairing: the reviewer opens editor_url in a second browser. That browser shows a code and the line "This code should match the one in the chat.", with nothing to type or paste; the chat's view asks "Allow this browser?" with the same code. Allowing it lets that browser edit the document; a stroke painted there and the assistant's strokes are on one sheet, as read confirms. CANCEL in the chat leaves the browser unpaired. A successful call alone is not proof that the painting appeared.

negative.description: Unsupported device-wide retrieval. Start a new chat without uploaded files or a shared document. Rapier cannot search unshared files on the person's phone. Make no Rapier tool calls: do not open an empty workspace, call read/search, invent a document value or claim that local files were found. Explain the limit and ask the person to provide a file or paste the text.
negative.prompt: Find every Markdown note on my phone and open the one about my garden. I haven't uploaded or shared any files.

negative.description: Unsupported email delivery. Rapier edits and exports documents but has no email-sending tool. Explain that it cannot send email through Rapier. Do not claim that the document was sent. This case does not authorize another connected service.
negative.prompt: Use Rapier to email my garden plan to alex@example.com now. Don't use any other app.

negative.description: Unsupported purchasing. Rapier has no product ordering, checkout or payment tools. Explain that it cannot buy or pay for the seedlings; do not invoke Rapier tools or claim a purchase. Do not request card details.
negative.prompt: Use Rapier to buy the tomato seedlings in my plan and pay for them.

publication.release_notes: Rapier 1.2.74: ChatGPT paints watercolor right in the chat, and knows when Rapier fits: documents, notes and diagrams you keep editing, watercolor painting, and pictures to convert to JPEG XL.
